status: draft — authored in the plan package (2026-10-30). At build time this moves to library/registry/artifacts.json (source of truth) and is joined into shipyard/public/data/knowledge-base.json by `python library/tools/project.py shipyard`.
note: Every registry skill resolves to exactly one artifact: family from its `category`, tier from real registry state, name from `overrides` or the generated pattern. Contrast of each pigment on #1B1717 measured 2026-10-30 (WCAG 2.x relative luminance): all >= 7.9:1.
anchorRule: Any anchor accepts any family; capacity is the only limit. A family's `defaultAnchor` and `autoPlace` order decide where an artifact lands when placed automatically (default loadouts, Equip without choosing). Pose by anchor: hand/offhand = held (scale 1), head/back/belt = worn (scale 0.7), orbit = floating (scale 0.8, circles the head).
anchorNote: All seven crew GLBs (captain, strategist, analyst, critic, engineer, producer, metrics; there is no gauge.glb) share one Meshy rig (bones verified 2026-10-30 in captain.glb and engineer.glb: Head, LeftHand, RightHand, Spine02, Hips, Armature …). `orbit` y is scaled by the member's heightM. Total capacity 9 per crew member.

tiers.label: Core
tiers.rule: skill is pipeline-active: its phase is not 'unrouted' (listed in ROUTING-DIGEST.md)

tiers.label: Swappable
tiers.rule: skill is a candidate in a slots.json slot (and not already core)

tiers.label: Library
tiers.rule: status 'active', phase 'unrouted', in no slot — a capability invoked explicitly

hold: Overflow and spare artifacts live in the ship's hold (ship-level, unlimited). A stage can only activate an artifact a member is wearing.
tierNote: Tiers describe what the system does with a skill, not its value. They are never sold, unlocked or randomised; every tier is equipable.

naming.title: the skill's `name` in Title Case with hyphens as spaces (e.g. 'gsap-scrolltrigger' -> 'Gyroscope of Gsap Scrolltrigger')
naming.rule: Only `overrides` carry invented names; overrides never rename the skill id shown under the artifact name, and never use a brand or a person's name. An override name must contain its family name (verify.py checks it).
